title: Load product catalog successfully
description: Verify that the product catalog page loads correctly displaying all product fields including name, description, image, price, and category.

steps.description: Navigate to the product catalog page.
Verify that all products are listed with correct name, description, image, price, and category.

title: View product details correctly
description: Verify that selecting a product from the catalog shows the correct product details including all fields.

steps.description: Navigate to the product catalog page.
Select a product to view its details.
Verify the product details page shows correct name, description, image, price, and category for the selected product.

title: Login success with hardcoded test account
description: Verify that user can login successfully with the correct hardcoded test account credentials.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter correct hardcoded test account email and password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login succeeds and user is redirected to the product catalog or appropriate landing page.

title: Login failure with incorrect credentials
description: Verify that login fails with invalid email or password and appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to the login page.
Enter invalid email and/or password.
Click the login button.
Verify that login fails and an error message is shown indicating invalid credentials.

title: Simulated product purchase and order recording
description: Verify that a logged-in user can perform a simulated purchase of a product and the order is recorded in order history.

steps.description: Login with valid test account.
Navigate to product catalog and select a product.
Perform simulated purchase of the selected product.
Verify that the purchase is successful and order is recorded in user's order history.

title: Order history displays all past purchases
description: Verify that the order history page accurately shows all previously purchased products for the logged-in user.

steps.description: Login with valid test account that has purchase history.
Navigate to the order history page.
Verify that all past purchased products are listed correctly with accurate purchase details.

title: Admin can add new product
description: Verify that admin user can add a new product through the admin page and it appears in the product catalog.

steps.description: Login as admin user.
Navigate to the admin page.
Use the add product feature to add a new product with all required fields.
Verify that the new product is added successfully and visible in the product catalog.

title: Admin can edit existing product
description: Verify that admin user can edit an existing product and changes are reflected in the product catalog.

steps.description: Login as admin user.
Navigate to the admin page.
Select an existing product and modify its fields.
Save the changes.
Verify that the product changes are saved and displayed correctly in the product catalog.

title: Admin can delete existing product
description: Verify that admin user can delete a product and it is removed from the product catalog.

steps.description: Login as admin user.
Navigate to the admin page.
Delete an existing product.
Verify that the product is removed and no longer listed in the product catalog.

title: Frontend navigation between key pages
description: Verify that frontend routes correctly between catalog, product details, login, order history, and admin pages.

steps.description: Navigate to product catalog page.
Click to view product details.
Navigate to login page.
Login successfully.
Navigate to order history page.
If admin, navigate to admin page.
Verify that navigation succeeds with correct page content rendered for each route.

title: Backend REST API returns correct product data
description: Verify that backend API endpoints return accurate and complete product information as expected.

steps.description: Send a GET request to the products API endpoint.
Verify that the response includes all products with correct fields: name, description, image, price, and category.

title: Backend REST API supports order purchase recording
description: Verify that backend API accepts purchase requests and records orders correctly in local storage.

steps.description: Login and obtain authentication token if needed.
Send a POST request to purchase API endpoint with product and user details.
Verify API response confirms purchase success and order is stored correctly.

title: Backend REST API returns correct order history
description: Verify that the order history API endpoint returns accurate order data for the logged-in user.

steps.description: Login as user with purchase history.
Send a GET request to order history API endpoint.
Verify the returned data matches the user's past purchases.

title: All data operations function fully locally
description: Verify that all app functionality works without any external service calls and all data is managed locally.

steps.description: Use network inspection tools to monitor external calls.
Perform browsing, login, purchase, order viewing, and admin operations.
Verify there are no external network calls and data is handled/stored locally.

title: Edge case: Purchase invalid product ID
description: Verify the system handles purchase requests for invalid or non-existent product IDs gracefully.

steps.description: Login as valid user.
Send a purchase request with an invalid product ID.
Verify the system returns an error response and does not record the order.

title: Edge case: Admin attempts to add product with missing required fields
description: Verify that the admin interface prevents adding products with missing mandatory fields.

steps.description: Login as admin user.
Attempt to add a product without specifying required fields (e.g., name or price).
Verify the UI shows validation errors and product is not added.

title: Edge case: Order history empty state
description: Verify that the order history page handles users with no purchase history gracefully.

steps.description: Login with a user account that has no orders.
Navigate to the order history page.
Verify the page shows appropriate message indicating no past orders.

title: Unauthorized access to admin page blocked
description: Verify that non-admin users or unauthenticated visitors cannot access the admin page.

steps.description: Navigate to the admin page without logging in.
Verify access is denied and user is redirected or shown an error.
Login as normal user.
Attempt to access admin page.
Verify access is denied for non-admin user.
